about: The secret of the Second Sunday of Advent, said quietly over the gifts. It asks God to accept prayer and offering where merits do not suffice — the defense is to be His, not ours.

s01.translation: Lord, we pray, let our humble prayers and offerings appease You; where merits offer no support, come to our aid through Your protection. Through the Lord.

w001.explanation: This is the petition “be appeased”, not the statement “Thou art appeased”.
